results.name: requisitions: search title
results.sql: SELECT "requisitions".* FROM "requisitions" WHERE "requisitions"."company_id" = 1 AND (requisitions.title ILIKE '%monitors batch 12345%' OR requisitions.number ILIKE '%monitors batch 12345%') ORDER BY "requisitions"."created_at" DESC LIMIT 25 OFFSET 0

results.name: approval inbox: manager
results.plan: Sort → Seq Scan on requisitions → Seq Scan on approval_steps → Bitmap Heap Scan on requisitions
results.sql: SELECT "requisitions".* FROM "requisitions" WHERE "requisitions"."company_id" = 1 AND "requisitions"."status" = 'pending_approval' AND "requisitions"."requester_id" != 2 AND "requisitions"."id" IN (SELECT "approval_steps"."requisition_id" FROM "approval_steps" WHERE "approval_steps"."company_id" = 1 AND "approval_steps"."status" = 'pending' AND "approval_steps"."company_id" = 1 AND (NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM approval_steps earlier WHERE earlier.requisition_id = approval_steps.requisition_id AND earlier.status = 'pending' AND earlier.level < approval_steps.level )) AND ("approval_steps"."approver_id" = 2 OR "approval_steps"."approver_id" IS NULL AND "approval_steps"."approver_role" = 'manager' AND "approval_steps"."requisition_id" IN (SELECT "requisitions"."id" FROM "requisitions" WHERE "requisitions"."company_id" = 1 AND "requisitions"."department_id" = 3))) ORDER BY "requisitions"."submitted_at" ASC LIMIT 25 OFFSET 0

results.name: dashboard: spend by department
results.plan: Sort → Seq Scan on requisitions → Seq Scan on departments
results.sql: SELECT departments.name, sum(total_amount) FROM "requisitions" INNER JOIN "departments" ON "departments"."company_id" = 1 AND "departments"."id" = "requisitions"."department_id" WHERE "requisitions"."company_id" = 1 AND "requisitions"."status" IN ('approved', 'ordered') AND "requisitions"."approved_at" >= '2026-08-08 07:00:47.008549' GROUP BY "departments"."name"
